_readme: Draft Order Games: the commissioner makes the league compete for draft order every year. Fill in one entry per year: 'competition' (short name), 'description' (how it was played), 'winner' (a manager id from data/managers.json, e.g. 'ryan-nussdorfer', or null) and optional 'notes'. The actual draft order is pulled automatically from the ESPN/Sleeper draft data; don't type it here. Rebuild with: python3 scripts/build_all.py. Optional 'video': {src, poster, type, width, height, caption} plays inline on the year's card (poster sized like the Lore photos); files live in src/static/media/draft-order/.
